api_contract.init_extra_setup_c:
struct i2c_master_s *bus_handle = (struct i2c_master_s *)board_i2cbus_initialize(1);
if (bus_handle == NULL) { return DRIVERGEN_EVAL_ERR_INVALID; }

test_stimuli.name: led0_duty_50_percent
test_stimuli.derivation: For LED0: OFF_L=0x00, OFF_H=0x00 => duty = (0x00 & 0x0F)*256 + 0x00 = 0. For LED1: OFF_L=0x00, OFF_H=0x00 => duty = 0.

test_stimuli.name: led0_duty_25_percent
test_stimuli.derivation: For LED0: OFF_L=0x00, OFF_H=0x04 => duty = (0x04 & 0x0F)*256 + 0x00 = 4*256 = 1024. For LED1: OFF_L=0x00, OFF_H=0x00 => duty = 0.

test_stimuli.name: led0_duty_100_percent
test_stimuli.derivation: For LED0: OFF_L=0xFF, OFF_H=0x0F => duty = (0x0F & 0x0F)*256 + 0xFF = 15*256 + 255 = 4095. For LED1: OFF_L=0xFF, OFF_H=0x0F => duty = 4095.
